f.title: Send safety reports to Roszdravnadzor through the AIS Roszdravnadzor
f.statement: Subjects of circulation of medicinal products (including MAHs) send reports (individual safety reports) to Roszdravnadzor through the Roszdravnadzor automated information system (AIS Roszdravnadzor).
f.legal_basis: Regulation on Roszdravnadzor (Gov. Resolution No. 323), sub-point 5.8(1)

rows.actor: Subjects of circulation of medicinal products, including the marketing authorisation holder
rows.quote:
7. Сообщения направляются субъектами обращения лекарственных средств
в Федеральную службу по надзору в сфере здравоохранения посредством
автоматизированной информационной системы Росздравнадзора (далее - АИС
Росздравнадзора)
rows.review_note: Review: quote verbatim; independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers. Double-check: statement stays within the quote. Present-tense "направляются" in a normative act read as a binding rule (Mandatory).
rows.quote_en: 7. Reports are sent by subjects of circulation of medicinal products to the Federal Service for Surveillance in Healthcare through the automated information system of Roszdravnadzor (hereinafter, AIS Roszdravnadzor).

f.title: Use the e-mail fallback when the AIS or the company safety database is down
f.statement: If AIS Roszdravnadzor has technical problems, reports are sent to Roszdravnadzor's pharmacovigilance e-mail address. If the safety database of the MAH or of the legal entity holding the clinical trial permit has technical problems, reports are also sent to that e-mail address, stating the expected time when the database will resume operation.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (ДРУ: holder of the registration certificate or a legal entity it authorises); or Legal entity holding the clinical trial permit (sponsor) in the Russian Federation
rows.quote:
8. В случае возникновения технических проблем в работе АИС
Росздравнадзора сообщения направляются по адресу электронной почты
rows.review_note: Review: quote verbatim; independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers. Double-check: statement stays within the quote. The quote stops before the second e-mail address (the checker refuses addresses), so the duty to state the expected database recovery time (same sentence, after the address) is not in the quote; statement relies on the translation for that clause.
rows.quote_en: 8. In the event of technical problems in the operation of AIS Roszdravnadzor, reports are sent to the e-mail address [Roszdravnadzor PV address]. In the event of technical problems in the operation of the databases of MAHs or of legal entities to whom permission to conduct clinical trials has been issued, reports are also sent to the e-mail address

f.title: Enter e-mailed reports into the AIS once systems are restored
f.statement: Reports sent by e-mail because of AIS Roszdravnadzor or company database outages must be entered by the MAH into AIS Roszdravnadzor immediately after the database of the subject of circulation or AIS Roszdravnadzor is working again.
f.applicability: Reports sent by e-mail in the cases in point 8

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (ДРУ: holder of the registration certificate or a legal entity it authorises)
rows.deadline: Immediately after the database or AIS is restored
rows.quote:
должны
быть внесены ДРУ в АИС Росздравнадзора сразу после восстановления
работоспособности базы данных субъекта обращения лекарственных средств
или АИС Росздравнадзора.
rows.review_note: Review: quote verbatim; independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers. Double-check: statement stays within the quote. "должны" = must.

f.title: Use the recommended report forms for e-mailed reports (Annex 1 marketed products; Annex 2 SUSARs in clinical trials)
f.statement: Reports sent by e-mail under points 8 and 10 for medicinal products registered or permitted in the Russian Federation (other than products intended for clinical trials) take the form of a notification of an adverse reaction or lack of therapeutic effect (recommended form, Annex 1). For medicinal products intended for clinical trials they take the form of a report of a serious unexpected adverse reaction to a medicinal product studied in a clinical trial (recommended form, Annex 2).

rows.actor: Subjects of circulation sending reports by e-mail, including the marketing authorisation holder and the clinical trial permit holder
rows.quote:

отношении зарегистрированных в Российской Федерации лекарственных
препаратов, а также лекарственных препаратов, обращение которых допускается
в соответствии с законодательством Российской Федерации в сфере обращения
лекарственных средств, за исключением лекарственных препаратов,
предназначенных для проведения клинических исследований, осуществляется
по электронной почте извещением о нежелательной реакции или отсутствии
терапевтического эффекта лекарственного препарата (рекомендуемый образец
приведен в приложении № 1 к Порядку). В отношении лекарственных

rows.review_note: Review: quote verbatim; independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers. Double-check: statement stays within the quote. Level Recommended: the forms are expressly "рекомендуемый образец" (recommended form); the e-mail route itself applies only in the fallback cases.

Reports under points 8 and 10 of the Procedure for medicinal products registered in the Russian Federation, and for medicinal products whose circulation is permitted under the legislation of the Russian Federation on the circulation of medicinal products, except medicinal products intended for clinical trials, are sent by e-mail as a notification of an adverse reaction or lack of therapeutic effect of a medicinal product (the recommended form is given in Annex No. 1 to the Procedure). For medicinal products intended for clinical trials, as a report of a serious unexpected adverse reaction to a medicinal product studied in a clinical trial (the recommended form is given in Annex No. 2 to the Procedure).

f.title: Operate a PV system that complies with EAEU Good Pharmacovigilance Practice
f.statement: The pharmacovigilance system organised by the MAH must comply with the Rules of Good Pharmacovigilance Practice of the Eurasian Economic Union (EEC Council Decision No. 87 of 3 November 2016).
f.legal_basis: EEC Council Decision No. 87 (3 Nov 2016), as amended by Decision No. 81 (19 May 2022)

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (ДРУ: holder of the registration certificate or a legal entity it authorises)
rows.quote:
12. Система фармаконадзора, организуемая ДРУ, должна соответствовать
Правилам надлежащей практики фармаконадзора Евразийского экономического
союза, утвержденным Решением Совета Евразийской экономической комиссии
от 3 ноября 2016 г. № 874 (далее - Надлежащая практика фармаконадзора).

rows.quote_en: 12. The pharmacovigilance system organised by the MAH must comply with the Rules of Good Pharmacovigilance Practice of the Eurasian Economic Union approved by Decision No. 87 of the Council of the Eurasian Economic Commission of 3 November 2016 (hereinafter, Good Pharmacovigilance Practice).

f.title: Submit clinical trial safety information in line with EAEU Good Clinical Practice
f.statement: The procedure for submitting safety information during clinical trials must comply with the Rules of Good Clinical Practice of the Eurasian Economic Union (EEC Council Decision No. 79 of 3 November 2016).

rows.actor: Legal entity holding the clinical trial permit (sponsor) in the Russian Federation
rows.quote:
Порядок представления информации по безопасности в ходе клинических
исследований должен соответствовать Правилам надлежащей клинической
rows.review_note: Review: quote verbatim; independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers. Double-check: statement stays within the quote. rows.quote_en: The procedure for submitting safety information during clinical trials must comply with the Rules of good clinical [practice]

f.title: Notify Roszdravnadzor of an emerging safety issue within 3 working days, by e-mail with paper follow-up
f.statement: MAHs send Roszdravnadzor information falling under the definition of an emerging safety issue (points 756 and 757 of EAEU GVP) within 3 working days, to the dedicated Roszdravnadzor e-mail address, with mandatory follow-up delivery on paper.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (ДРУ: holder of the registration certificate or a legal entity it authorises)
rows.quote:
13. ДРУ в течение 3 рабочих дней направляют в Росздравнадзор
информацию, подпадающую под определение экстренной проблемы
безопасности, в соответствии с пунктами 756 и 757 Надлежащей практики
фармаконадзора, по адресу электронной почты
rows.review_note: Review: quote verbatim; independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers. Double-check: statement stays within the quote. The quote stops before the e-mail address (checker refuses addresses); the mandatory paper follow-up ("с обязательным досылом на бумажном носителе") follows the address in the same sentence. The source does not say from which event the 3 working days run; clock_start quotes the time-limit words.
rows.quote_en: 13. MAHs, within 3 working days, send to Roszdravnadzor information falling under the definition of an emerging safety issue in accordance with points 756 and 757 of Good Pharmacovigilance Practice, to the e-mail address

f.title: Submit PSURs, DSURs and RMPs through the AIS Roszdravnadzor
f.statement: Periodic reporting documents (PSURs, DSURs) and RMPs are sent to Roszdravnadzor through AIS Roszdravnadzor, where they are registered automatically.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (ДРУ: holder of the registration certificate or a legal entity it authorises); or Legal entity holding the clinical trial permit (sponsor) in the Russian Federation
rows.quote:
14. Документы периодической отчетности - ПООБ, РООБ, а также ПУР,
направляются в Росздравнадзор посредством АИС Росздравнадзора и
регистрируются автоматически.
rows.review_note: Review: quote verbatim; independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: 14. Periodic reporting documents - PSURs, DSURs, and also RMPs - are sent to Roszdravnadzor through AIS Roszdravnadzor and are registered automatically.

f.title: Prepare PSURs in line with EAEU GVP section VIII
f.statement: MAHs submit to Roszdravnadzor a PSUR that meets the requirements of section VIII "Periodic safety update report" of EAEU Good Pharmacovigilance Practice.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (ДРУ: holder of the registration certificate or a legal entity it authorises)
rows.quote:
15. ДРУ представляют в Росздравнадзор ПООБ, соответствующий
требованиям раздела VIII «Периодический обновляемый отчет по безопасности»
Надлежащей практики фармаконадзора.
rows.review_note: Review: quote verbatim; independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: 15. MAHs submit to Roszdravnadzor a PSUR that meets the requirements of section VIII "Periodic safety update report" of Good Pharmacovigilance Practice.

f.title: Apply the EAEU PSUR schedule (point 698) to EAEU-registered products; otherwise points 696-697
f.statement: The PSUR submission procedure in point 698 of EAEU GVP applies to medicinal products registered under, or brought into conformity with, the EAEU registration requirements. For other products the PSUR periodicity and timelines are those set by points 696 and 697 of EAEU GVP.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (ДРУ: holder of the registration certificate or a legal entity it authorises)
rows.quote:
16. Порядок представления ПООБ в соответствии с пунктом 698 Надлежащей
практики фармаконадзора распространяется на лекарственные препараты,
прошедшие процедуру регистрации или приведённые в соответствие с
требованиями регистрации Евразийского экономического союза. В остальных
случаях требования к периодичности и срокам предоставления ПООБ
определяются пунктами 696 и 697 Надлежащей практики фармаконадзора.
rows.review_note: Review: quote verbatim; independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: 16. The procedure for submitting PSURs in accordance with point 698 of Good Pharmacovigilance Practice applies to medicinal products that have undergone the registration procedure or been brought into conformity with the registration requirements of the Eurasian Economic Union. In other cases the requirements for the periodicity and timing of PSUR submission are determined by points 696 and 697 of Good Pharmacovigilance Practice.

f.title: Submit an ad hoc PSUR when Roszdravnadzor requests one
f.statement: Where new adverse reactions or other safety and efficacy information not in the SmPC or instructions for use change the benefit-risk balance, or the PSUR submission requirements (points 14-16) are not met, Roszdravnadzor considers within 5 working days whether to request an ad hoc PSUR from the MAH under point 701 of EAEU GVP; the MAH must then provide it.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (ДРУ: holder of the registration certificate or a legal entity it authorises)
rows.quote:
Росздравнадзор в течение 5 рабочих дней со дня выявления указанных сведений
рассматривает вопрос о необходимости запроса у ДРУ внеочередного ПООБ, в
соответствии с пунктом 701 Надлежащей практики фармаконадзора.
rows.review_note: Review: quote verbatim; re-translation agrees. Double-check: the point states an authority duty; the company duty to answer an ad hoc PSUR request comes from GVP point 701 and is implied here. Kept because it defines when MAHs can expect requests.
rows.quote_en: Roszdravnadzor, within 5 working days from the day the said information is identified, considers the need to request an ad hoc PSUR from the MAH in accordance with point 701 of Good Pharmacovigilance Practice.

f.title: Report SUSARs and other trial safety information under EAEU GCP Annex 11
f.statement: Information on suspected unexpected serious adverse reactions to an investigational medicinal product and other safety information in an interventional clinical trial is sent to Roszdravnadzor in accordance with points 1 and 2.2 of Annex 11 to EAEU Good Clinical Practice.

f.title: Submit DSURs in line with EAEU GCP Annex 12
f.statement: Legal entities holding a clinical trial permit submit DSURs to Roszdravnadzor in accordance with Annex 12 to EAEU Good Clinical Practice.

rows.actor: Legal entity holding the clinical trial permit (sponsor) in the Russian Federation
rows.quote:
19. Юридические лица, на имя которых выдано разрешение на проведение
клинических исследований, представляют в Росздравнадзор РООБ в
соответствии с требованиями приложения № 12 к Надлежащей клинической
практики.

rows.quote_en: 19. Legal entities to whom permission to conduct clinical trials has been issued submit DSURs to Roszdravnadzor in accordance with the requirements of Annex No. 12 to Good Clinical Practice.

f.title: Resubmit a rejected PSUR or DSUR within 30 working days of the rejection notice
f.statement: When notified in its AIS personal account that a PSUR (points 587-687, 690 of EAEU GVP) or DSUR (Annex 12 to EAEU GCP) has been rejected, the MAH or clinical trial permit holder sends Roszdravnadzor, within no more than 30 working days of receiving the electronic notice, the PSUR or DSUR brought into conformity and taking account of the expert organisation's comments.
f.legal_basis: EAEU GVP points 587-687; EAEU GCP Annex 12
f.exceptions: Three consecutive non-compliant PSURs or DSURs for one product are reported to Roszdravnadzor, which decides on an unscheduled PV system inspection (points 33-34).

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (ДРУ: holder of the registration certificate or a legal entity it authorises); or Legal entity holding the clinical trial permit (sponsor) in the Russian Federation
rows.deadline: Within 30 working days of receiving the electronic rejection notice
rows.quote:
32. ДРУ лекарственного препарата или юридическое лицо, на имя которого
выдано разрешение на проведение клинических исследований, в срок, не
превышающий 30 рабочих дней со дня получения электронного уведомления
Росздравнадзора, указанного в пункте 31 Порядка, направляет в Росздравнадзор
ПООБ, приведенный в соответствие с требованиями пунктов 587-687
Надлежащей практики фармаконадзора, с учетом замечаний экспертной
организации, или РООБ, приведенный в соответствие с требованиями
приложения № 12 к Надлежащей клинической практике, с учетом замечаний
экспертной организации.
rows.review_note: Review: quote verbatim; independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: 32. The MAH of the medicinal product or the legal entity to whom permission to conduct clinical trials has been issued, within no more than 30 working days from the day of receipt of the electronic notice of Roszdravnadzor referred to in point 31 of the Procedure, sends to Roszdravnadzor the PSUR brought into conformity with the requirements of points 587-687 of Good Pharmacovigilance Practice, taking account of the comments of the expert organisation, or the DSUR brought into conformity with the requirements of Annex No. 12 to Good Clinical Practice, taking account of the comments of the expert organisation.

f.title: Analyse the reliability of new safety data within 10 working days of notification and submit the results
f.statement: Within 10 working days of receiving Roszdravnadzor's notice of new safety data (data not in the SmPC, instructions for use or trial documentation that change the benefit-risk balance), the MAH or clinical trial permit holder analyses the reliability of the information and submits the results to Roszdravnadzor.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (ДРУ: holder of the registration certificate or a legal entity it authorises); or Legal entity holding the clinical trial permit (sponsor) in the Russian Federation
rows.deadline: Within 10 working days of receiving the Roszdravnadzor notice
rows.quote:
40. ДРУ лекарственного препарата или юридическое лицо, на имя которого
выдано разрешение на проведение клинических исследований, в течение 10
рабочих дней со дня получения уведомления Росздравнадзора, указанного в
пункте 38 Порядка, проводит анализ достоверности полученной информации о
новых данных по безопасности (анализ достоверности информации) и
результаты представляет в Росздравнадзор.
rows.review_note: Review: quote verbatim; independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: 40. The MAH of the medicinal product or the legal entity to whom permission to conduct clinical trials has been issued, within 10 working days from the day of receipt of the Roszdravnadzor notice referred to in point 38 of the Procedure, analyses the reliability of the information received on the new safety data (reliability analysis) and submits the results to Roszdravnadzor.

deadline_rule.clock_start:
получения уведомления Росздравнадзора, указанного в
пункте 38 Порядка
deadline_rule.applies_to: new safety data notified by Roszdravnadzor

f.title: Send a preliminary response on urgent measures within 10 working days when a more detailed check is needed
f.statement: Where the MAH or clinical trial permit holder needs to carry out a more detailed check of the product's quality, efficacy and safety, it submits to Roszdravnadzor, within 10 working days of receiving the notice, a preliminary response on whether urgent measures concerning the further circulation of the product are or are not needed.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (ДРУ: holder of the registration certificate or a legal entity it authorises); or Legal entity holding the clinical trial permit (sponsor) in the Russian Federation
rows.deadline: Within 10 working days of receiving the Roszdravnadzor notice
rows.quote:
клинических исследований, более детальной проверки качества, эффективности
и безопасности лекарственного препарата, в течение 10 рабочих дней со дня
получения уведомления Росздравнадзора ДРУ или юридическое лицо, на имя
которого выдано разрешение на проведение клинических исследований,
представляет в Росздравнадзор предварительный ответ о необходимости или
отсутствии необходимости принятия срочных мер по дальнейшему обращению
лекарственного препарата.
rows.review_note: Review: quote verbatim; independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers. Double-check: statement stays within the quote. The quote starts after footnote 7, which splits point 40 in the scan; the opening words are bracketed in quote_en for context.
rows.quote_en: [Where the MAH or the legal entity to whom permission to conduct] clinical trials [has been issued needs to carry out] a more detailed check of the quality, efficacy and safety of the medicinal product, within 10 working days from the day of receipt of the Roszdravnadzor notice the MAH or the legal entity to whom permission to conduct clinical trials has been issued submits to Roszdravnadzor a preliminary response on the need or absence of need to take urgent measures regarding the further circulation of the medicinal product.

deadline_rule.applies_to: preliminary response where a more detailed check is needed

f.title: Determine the risk and take risk-reduction measures during the reliability analysis
f.statement: During the reliability analysis, the MAH or clinical trial permit holder takes measures to determine the risk associated with circulation of the product, and a set of measures to prevent or reduce the likelihood of related adverse reactions or to reduce their severity or impact on the patient if they occur.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (ДРУ: holder of the registration certificate or a legal entity it authorises); or Legal entity holding the clinical trial permit (sponsor) in the Russian Federation
rows.quote:
41. В период проведения анализа достоверности информации, указанного в
пункте 40 Порядка, ДРУ лекарственного препарата или юридическое лицо, на
имя которого выдано разрешение на проведение клинических исследований,
принимает меры для определения риска, связанного с обращением
соответствующего лекарственного препарата, а также комплекс мероприятий,
направленных на предотвращение или уменьшение вероятности возникновения
нежелательных реакций, связанных с воздействием лекарственного препарата,
либо на уменьшение степени тяжести или влияния нежелательных реакций на
пациента в случае их развития.
rows.review_note: Review: quote verbatim; independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: 41. During the reliability analysis referred to in point 40 of the Procedure, the MAH of the medicinal product or the legal entity to whom permission to conduct clinical trials has been issued takes measures to determine the risk associated with the circulation of the relevant medicinal product, and also a set of measures aimed at preventing or reducing the likelihood of adverse reactions associated with exposure to the medicinal product, or at reducing the severity or impact of adverse reactions on the patient if they develop.

f.title: Prepare the RMP in the format and content of EAEU GVP section VI (subsections 5 and 6)
f.statement: The RMP must meet the requirements of subsections 5 (overview of RMP format and content) and 6 (detailed description of each RMP part) of section VI "Risk management system" of EAEU GVP.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (ДРУ: holder of the registration certificate or a legal entity it authorises)
rows.quote:
44. ПУР должен соответствовать требованиям подразделов 5 «Обзор формата
и содержания плана управления рисками» и 6 «Подробное описание каждой
части плана управления рисками» раздела VI «Система управления рисками»
Надлежащей практики фармаконадзора.
rows.review_note: Review: quote verbatim; independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: 44. The RMP must meet the requirements of subsections 5 "Overview of the format and content of the risk management plan" and 6 "Detailed description of each part of the risk management plan" of section VI "Risk management system" of Good Pharmacovigilance Practice.

f.title: Submit a requested RMP within 60 working days of the Roszdravnadzor request
f.statement: An RMP requested by Roszdravnadzor (after review of the reliability analysis, under point 352 of EAEU GVP) is to be sent to Roszdravnadzor within 60 working days of receiving the request.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (ДРУ: holder of the registration certificate or a legal entity it authorises)
rows.deadline: Within 60 working days of receiving the request
rows.quote:
45. ПУР подлежит направлению в Росздравнадзор в течение 60 рабочих дней
со дня получения запроса Росздравнадзора, указанного в пункте 43 Порядка.
rows.review_note: Review: quote verbatim; independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers. Double-check: statement stays within the quote. "подлежит направлению" = is to be sent (binding).
rows.quote_en: 45. The RMP is to be sent to Roszdravnadzor within 60 working days from the day of receipt of the Roszdravnadzor request referred to in point 43 of the Procedure.

f.title: MAH may develop and submit an RMP on its own initiative
f.statement: Where the MAH's reliability analysis shows the product does not meet efficacy and safety requirements, the MAH is entitled to develop an RMP on its own initiative and submit it to Roszdravnadzor (EAEU GVP point 233(b)). An RMP may also be submitted on the basis of data the MAH itself has identified.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (ДРУ: holder of the registration certificate or a legal entity it authorises)
rows.quote:
46. При выявлении ДРУ в ходе проведения анализа достоверности
информации, указанной в пункте 40 Порядка, информации о несоответствии
лекарственного препарата требованиям эффективности и безопасности, ДРУ
лекарственного препарата вправе самостоятельно разработать ПУР и
представить его в Росздравнадзор в соответствии с подпунктом «б» пункта 233
Надлежащей практики фармаконадзора. Возможно предоставление ПУР в
Росздравнадзор на основании данных, выявленных самим ДРУ.
rows.review_note: Review: quote verbatim; independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers. Double-check: statement stays within the quote. "вправе"/"возможно" = Permitted.
rows.quote_en: 46. Where, during the reliability analysis referred to in point 40 of the Procedure, the MAH identifies information on non-compliance of the medicinal product with efficacy and safety requirements, the MAH of the medicinal product is entitled to develop an RMP on its own initiative and submit it to Roszdravnadzor in accordance with sub-point "b" of point 233 of Good Pharmacovigilance Practice. Submission of an RMP to Roszdravnadzor on the basis of data identified by the MAH itself is possible.

f.title: Include important risks, missing information, PV activities and risk minimisation with effectiveness evaluation in the RMP
f.statement: The RMP includes a detailed description of the important risks and missing information on the product's safety, of the pharmacovigilance activities to identify new and assess existing safety concerns, and of risk minimisation measures, including evaluation of their effectiveness, in accordance with points 237-344 of EAEU GVP.
f.processes: Risk management & minimisation; Epidemiology / safety studies

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (ДРУ: holder of the registration certificate or a legal entity it authorises)
rows.quote:
47. ПУР включает подробное описание важных рисков лекарственного
препарата и отсутствующей информации о его безопасности, а также подробное
описание мероприятий по фармаконадзору, направленных на выявление новых
и оценку имеющихся проблем по безопасности, и подробное описание мер
минимизации рисков, включая оценку эффективности данных мер, в
соответствии с пунктами 237-344 Надлежащей практики фармаконадзора.
rows.review_note: Review: quote verbatim; independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: 47. The RMP includes a detailed description of the important risks of the medicinal product and of missing information on its safety, and a detailed description of pharmacovigilance activities aimed at identifying new and assessing existing safety concerns, and a detailed description of risk minimisation measures, including evaluation of the effectiveness of those measures, in accordance with points 237-344 of Good Pharmacovigilance Practice.

f.title: Implement risk minimisation measures in line with EAEU GVP points 307-324
f.statement: Risk minimisation measures are implemented in accordance with points 307-324 of EAEU GVP. The expert organisation's opinion on the sufficiency of the RMP risk minimisation measures is posted in the MAH's AIS personal account within 30 working days of receipt of the RMP.
f.exceptions: Three consecutive non-compliant sets of additional risk minimisation materials are reported to Roszdravnadzor, which decides on suspension of use and an unscheduled PV system inspection (points 50-51).

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (ДРУ: holder of the registration certificate or a legal entity it authorises)
rows.quote:
Меры минимизации рисков осуществляются в
соответствии с пунктами 307-324
rows.review_note: Review: quote verbatim; re-translation agrees. Double-check: actor inferred (MAH implements RMMs); the 30-working-day opinion timeline is an expert-organisation duty, given as context.
rows.quote_en: Risk minimisation measures are implemented in accordance with points 307-324

f.title: Submit an updated RMP within 30 working days of a notice that changes are needed
f.statement: On receiving a notice that changes to the RMP are needed, the MAH submits the amended RMP to Roszdravnadzor within no more than 30 working days of receiving that notice.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (ДРУ: holder of the registration certificate or a legal entity it authorises)
rows.deadline: Within 30 working days of receiving the notice
rows.quote:
49. В случае получения уведомления о необходимости внесения изменений в
ПУР ДРУ лекарственного препарата в срок, не превышающий 30 рабочих дней
со дня получения данного уведомления, представляет в Росздравнадзор ПУР с
учетом внесенных изменений.
rows.review_note: Review: quote verbatim; independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: 49. Upon receipt of a notice of the need to make changes to the RMP, the MAH of the medicinal product, within no more than 30 working days from the day of receipt of that notice, submits to Roszdravnadzor the RMP taking account of the changes made.

dates.title: Roszdravnadzor Pharmacovigilance Procedure (Order 3518/2024): enters into force
dates.scope: All subjects of circulation of medicinal products for medical use in the Russian Federation (MAHs, clinical trial permit holders, medical organisations); replaces Order No. 1071 of 2017 and its 2020 amendment
